title: The end guard at guard_stream.py:324 gets a row and a mutant, and its doc drift and cwd gaps are fixed
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 16:00 CST Nov 8, from round-3 or later reviews; queued follow-up the lane starts when its wait ends. Waits on #1803. A row and a mutant for the end guard at guard_stream.py:324; doc drift at guard.py:78 and rule_mechanisms.json:356 ("tail or head"); "gate" wording in 3 lines; the LINT_SCRIPT false alarm on report scripts. From #2164 round 3: a payload cwd already in <repo>/lint is not read (guard_stream.py:480), and an unknown cwd or `cd $VAR/lint` reads the guard's own lint/ (guard_stream.py:349-357).
